body.p: A puma found himself at the edge of a haystack with a very gentle fox.
(It should be noted that this one had a colorful crest on his head.)
"What a beautiful decoration you are wearing, my friend! How did you make it?" spoke the beast.
"Very simply: I scraped my head with a flint, and then I inserted the beautiful rhea feathers into it."
"How admirable! I wish to submit to the same test. Do you want to go to the trouble of doing it for me?"
And the fox began to scratch the puma's skull, until he had thinned it enough to break it with a single blow of a flint.
